_about: Which content each access code opens. The codes themselves are not stored here: they live in the repository secret SITE_CODES as JSON, e.g. {"students": "ABC1234"}, keyed by the names below. The owner password (SITE_PASSWORD) always opens everything. List sections by their name in tools/hub.json, and single primers by slug in decks. An optional notice (plain text) is shown to code holders on every page; leave it empty for none.
